designPhilosophy.corePrinciple: Content is the hero. All UI elements must be minimal, recede into the background, and serve to enhance the reading and writing experience.

layout.whitespace: Generous use of whitespace to reduce cognitive load and improve focus.

articleEditor.name: Article Editor
articleEditor.description: A distraction-free environment for content creation and management.

elements.spec: Single, auto-expanding textarea for Markdown-supported content.
Prominent input field at the top of the page.
Floating Action Button (#A027F6) that expands to show AI options.
Primary action button, disabled until content is added.

generateCover.trigger: Button next to title field, active when title is present.
generateCover.flow: Opens modal for prompt refinement, generates 8K ultra-realistic image based on title/summary, user can accept or retry.

generateContent.trigger: Options revealed by AI Tools FAB.
generateContent.flow: Inserts AI-generated text (e.g., outline, headline) at cursor, highlighted for review.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Full-width editor with content centered in a readable column.
responsiveBehavior.tablet: Sidebar for settings collapses, more vertical spacing.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Single-column view. FAB is moved to the bottom-right for easy thumb access.

chronologicalPostList.name: Chronological Post List
chronologicalPostList.description: Displays all published articles in reverse chronological order.

elements.spec: Card-based design with Cover Image, Title, and a 2-line excerpt.
Seamlessly loads more posts as the user scrolls down.

responsiveBehavior.tablet: Feed takes up more screen width.

individualPostView.name: Individual Post View
individualPostView.description: Optimized reading experience for a single article.

elements.spec: Full-bleed 8K cover image followed by the article title.
High-contrast, legible text set in the 'Lora' typeface.
Subtle byline with author name and publication date.

responsiveBehavior.desktop: Content column max-width of 720px for optimal readability.
responsiveBehavior.mobile: Edge-to-edge content, typography adjusted for smaller screens.

topicSearchResults.name: Topic Search Results
topicSearchResults.description: Displays articles matching a user's search query.

elements.spec: Prominently displayed at the top of the page.
Similar to the chronological list, but with search terms highlighted.
Search query matches are highlighted with #FFC200.

responsiveBehavior.mobile: Full-width list, search bar is sticky at the top during scroll.

nonNegotiables: No clutter: prioritize whitespace and high-contrast typography.
Strict adherence to the defined color palette.
Image generation feature must target an 'Ultra Realistic 8K' style.
